THE IMPORTANT QUESTIONS

No black boxes.
Let’s talk plainly.

A good decision starts with knowing what exists, what fits and what needs validation.

Is it just a physical device?+

No. The value is the combination of the gateway software and a central platform to inventory, install, configure and track operations. The hardware and its suitability are assessed for each deployment.

What is implemented today?+

We have verified a working interface with an inventory of domains, networks and devices, versioned configurations, an OpenWrt installation flow, service configuration and an execution history with logs. The deployment scope is validated against your plant’s requirements.

Does it work with any machine?+

Integration depends on the protocols, permissions and connectors available. The local services offer a flexible base, but compatibility is validated per machine and use case. Universal connectivity is not promised.

Does it replace the PLC, the HMI or the SCADA?+

No. It provides data integration, local services and gateway management. Real-time industrial control, process visualisation and safety functions remain in the corresponding systems.

Do I have to use a Protectli?+

No. IoT Gateway NG is hardware-agnostic. The Protectli VP4651 with coreboot is the recommended device and includes iPXE. Other devices require validation of compatibility, resources and boot method. Live USB remains an alternative.

Where is Edge Manager installed?+

On the Internet or on the customer’s premises, depending on the project. Edge Manager manages the gateways. The integration services and local data processing run on the plant gateway.
